title: Skit pilot — the sharks broke the internet

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: The internet's down. It's the sharks. They bite the cables under the ocean.

lines.speaker: jo
lines.text: From 2007 to 2014, fish bites of every kind — sharks included — caused zero cable faults.

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: Zero? Then who keeps breaking them?

lines.speaker: jo
lines.text: Us. Fishing gear and ships' anchors. Seventy to eighty percent of the damage.

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: So when one snaps, it just stays broken?

lines.speaker: jo
lines.text: No. A ship sails out, drops a hook, hauls the cable up onto the deck, and splices in a new piece.

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: With a hook. The whole internet.

lines.speaker: jo
lines.text: It's about as thick as a garden hose.

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: Okay. Then what's actually at the bottom of the internet?

lines.speaker: jo
lines.text: Every level of it, all the way down, is linked right here.
